components.name: ApprovalCard
components.summary: The moment ZORIX stops and asks a person: the tool, the exact arguments, why, and a fingerprint of the call.

components.name: AutonomyDial
components.summary: How much a virtual employee or manager may do without asking: five levels, set per role.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: The face of an agent, a virtual employee or a person.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A word or two of state, in a tone: ok, warn, err, info, muted, accent.

components.name: BrandLogo
components.summary: A service's mark (Simple Icons, CC0) on a quiet tile; a plug for anything without one.

components.name: BrandMark
components.summary: The ZORIX mark: the layers icon on a tile filled with the brand gradient, beside the word ZORIX set in lead.

components.name: Button
components.summary: The one way to start an action: primary, secondary, ghost, danger and subtle, in three sizes.

components.name: Callout
components.summary: A message inside a page: a request, an error, a notice, a confirmation.

components.name: Card
components.summary: The surface for one subject: a header with an icon and actions, a body, an optional footer.

components.name: ChartPanel
components.summary: A chart in a Card: a headline figure, a range control, the chart and a breakdown.

components.name: ChatBubble
components.summary: One message in a conversation with an agent or a team.

components.name: Chip
components.summary: A removable or selectable value: a filter, a granted tool, a tag.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.summary: SQL, JSON, JavaScript and Python, highlighted by a tiny tokenizer with no network and no HTML.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.summary: ⌘K / Ctrl K: go anywhere, start anything, by typing.

components.name: Composer
components.summary: Where a person writes to an agent, a team or a workflow.

components.name: DelegationCard
components.summary: One call to agents.delegate: who was asked, their state, steps, share of the cost, and their answer.

components.name: DiffView
components.summary: What changed between two texts: word by word for a sentence, line by line for more.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: A sheet from the right for looking at one thing beside its list.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: What a screen shows before it has anything: an icon tile, one sentence and the first action.

components.name: Field
components.summary: Label, control, hint and error as one unit.

components.name: HealthGrid
components.summary: The health of every provider, integration and server at a glance: a state and 24 hours of history.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Lucide-style strokes on a 24px grid with a round 1.8px stroke, drawn as static markup from one file.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: A square button with only an icon, for toolbar and row actions.

components.name: KeyValue
components.summary: Facts about one thing as label and value (items).

components.name: List
components.summary: The divided list (List, ListRow with active and onclick).

components.name: ListingCard
components.summary: An agent, team, skill, integration or workflow offered in the Marketplace.

components.name: LogStream
components.summary: Events and logs as they happen: time, level, source and message, one line each.

components.name: Markdown
components.summary: Model answers and instructions rendered as Markdown, with citations to documents.

components.name: MetricTile
components.summary: A live number with its trend: label, value, change, a detail line and a sparkline.

components.name: Modal
components.summary: A dialog that asks one question and blocks the page until it is answered.

components.name: OrgChart
components.summary: The AI workforce as an organisation: virtual managers, department leads, virtual employees and the people they answer to.

components.name: PageHeader
components.summary: The title, subtitle and actions of a screen, over a faint accent wash.

components.name: Primitives
components.summary: The small parts: Spinner, Dot, Kbd, Skeleton and Divider.

components.name: ScoreMatrix
components.summary: Evaluation results: cases by version or model, each cell a score with its tone.

components.name: ScreenAgentChat
components.summary: A conversation with an agent or a team: messages, delegations, tool calls and approvals in the order they happened, with what the team knows and spent beside i…

components.name: ScreenAgentVersions
components.summary: How an agent changed and whether it got worse: every saved version, the difference between two, and evaluation scores by version and model.

components.name: ScreenAgents
components.summary: The gallery of agents: face, version, model, eval score, tools, and the last thing each did.

components.name: ScreenCommandCenter
components.summary: The home of an operator: live figures, spend against budget, everything waiting for a person, the health of every connection and the live log.

components.name: ScreenIntegrations
components.summary: Services and MCP servers, live: their state, what is granted, and the tools that wait for your review.

components.name: ScreenLogs
components.summary: The live log with filters, the trace of one workflow run as a waterfall of spans, and the details of the selected line.

components.name: ScreenMarketplace
components.summary: Browse and install agents, teams, workflows, skills and integrations.

components.name: ScreenMemory
components.summary: What ZORIX remembers: facts agents propose and people approve, folders of documents with their indexing state, and a place to try a question.

components.name: ScreenNewRun
components.summary: The form that starts a run: who runs it, what it should do, what it may use, its limits, and a summary of what it can do before you start.

components.name: ScreenProjectBoard
components.summary: A project's tasks by state, assigned to people and agents, with the project's progress, members and manager.

components.name: ScreenProjectTimeline
components.summary: The project's tasks across weeks: each a bar from start to due date, filled by progress, with who has it and a line for today.

components.name: ScreenProviders
components.summary: Where models come from: providers with their keys and health, the models each offers with prices, and routes that fall back when one fails.

components.name: ScreenRun
components.summary: One execution as it happens: its figures, the tree of agents it asked, each step, and the approval it is waiting for.

components.name: ScreenSettings
components.summary: The rules that decide what anything in ZORIX may do, how approvals behave, and who can approve.

components.name: ScreenWorkflowEditor
components.summary: The visual editor of a workflow: a palette of step kinds, the canvas, and the inspector of the selected step.

components.name: ScreenWorkflows
components.summary: Every workflow with its trigger, the result of its last 14 runs, its live version and whether it is on.

components.name: ScreenWorkforce
components.summary: The AI workforce: an org chart of virtual managers, leads and employees under the people they answer to, with the selected worker's figures, autonomy and week.

components.name: Sparkbar
components.summary: A small bar for a share of a total (value, max, label).

components.name: Stat
components.summary: A figure with a label, an icon and a detail line (label, value, detail, icon).

components.name: StatusPill
components.summary: The state of a server, integration or service: a dot, a word, a pulse while something is happening.

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: A short flow of three to five steps (steps, current).

components.name: Switch
components.summary: Checkbox and Switch: yes-or-no choices, with the label as children and an optional description.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Segmented control and tabs: switch between views of the same thing.

components.name: TaskBoard
components.summary: A project's tasks in columns by state, assigned to people or agents.

components.name: TaskCard
components.summary: One task: key, priority, title, progress, due date, dependencies and who has it.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: A short confirmation that floats in from the corner and leaves on its own.

components.name: ToggleRow
components.summary: A setting as a sentence and a switch, stacked inside a Card.

components.name: ToolCallCard
components.summary: One tool call in a run or a chat: the tool, its state, and the arguments and result on demand.

components.name: TreeView
components.summary: The work tree of a run: who was asked, by whom, what each cost and how it ended.

components.name: TriggerChip
components.summary: How a workflow starts, shown on its card, in lists and in the canvas header.

components.name: VersionTimeline
components.summary: The versions of an agent, a team or a workflow: every save is a new version; rollback writes a new one.

components.name: WorkerCard
components.summary: A virtual employee: face, name, role, status and three figures that matter for the role.

components.name: WorkflowCanvas
components.summary: The visual editor and live view of a workflow: triggers, agents, conditions, approvals and actions joined by edges.

components.name: WorkflowNode
components.summary: One step of a workflow.
